tasks.goal: Build and test a Node CLI tool 'csv-merger' that merges two CSV files on a shared key column and prints the combined rows, verifying it works on sample fixtures. As a FINAL SEPARATE PHASE, add a package.json and a README with a 'Verified invocations' section documenting the exact commands you ran and their output.

Create a workspace with three markdown files documenting recipes (soup.md, pasta.md, dessert.md) each with a title and short description. As a FINAL SEPARATE PHASE, write an index.md that links to all three files with accurate titles and descriptions.

Write a README.md with Overview, Installation, and Usage headings, and a CONTRIBUTING.md with Code of Conduct and Pull Request Process headings for a fictional 'weather-fetcher' project, plus an .eslintrc.json config file with an exact literal ruleset: {"env": {"node": true}, "rules": {"semi": ["error", "always"], "quotes": ["error", "single"]}}.

Build a small Node HTTP server (server.js) implementing a bookmarks API with routes GET /bookmarks, POST /bookmarks, DELETE /bookmarks/:id, each returning specific JSON bodies and status codes. As a FINAL SEPARATE PHASE, write a README.md documenting every route, request body, and status code exactly as implemented in server.js.

Build a single-page web app that lets a user log daily tide height readings for a coastal location and displays them as a sortable table with a simple line chart, all in one self-contained HTML file with embedded CSS and JS.

Build a small command-line app that splits a restaurant bill among a list of named diners, supporting itemized assignment and even split of shared items, with tax and tip proportionally distributed, and outputs a per-person summary.

Build a Node HTTP server (server.js) implementing a warehouse inventory API with routes GET /items, GET /items/:sku, PUT /items/:sku, POST /items/:sku/restock, each with defined JSON request/response shapes and status codes. As a FINAL SEPARATE PHASE, write a README.md documenting every route, its request body, response shape, and status codes exactly as implemented in server.js.
